summary: Frontend-only test of StoryViewer.js changes for consumer QA. Login, Home stories row (Teccel sponsored + QA Loja Normal organic), organic story auto-advance (~10s), progress bar animation, tap-right advance, tap-left back, hold-to-pause, sponsored no-auto-advance and static full progress bar, close, and contextmenu prevention on both viewer root and images — all verified. Tested on mobile 390x844 and tablet 820x1180.
critical_code_review_comments: StoryViewer.js hold-to-pause has a tiny leak (~1 tick / 50ms) because setHolding(true) → pausedRef sync happens on next render/effect. Not user-visible, but if you want perfect zero-leak pause, update pausedRef directly in onDown (pausedRef.current = true) alongside setHolding.

The organic layout images inside <ActionButtons> or absolute layer are non-draggable via CSS but the top absolute overlay div (z-[5]) already covers them for touch; ensure any future image additions also spread mediaGuard to keep contextmenu prevented (currently the img inside sponsored blurred layer uses mediaGuard — good).
IMG_DURATION and VIDEO_CAP are module constants; consider deriving from a config so QA and product can tune without code change.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of criteria (11/11 checks pass; hold-pause verified functionally with minor 50ms tick leak that is expected React state timing)

seed_data_creation: None. Fixtures already present (Teccel sponsored + QA Loja Normal organic).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Home renders data-testid='story-bubble' for organic and 'story-bubble-sponsored' for sponsored. Viewer root: data-testid='story-viewer'. Touch overlay: data-testid='story-touch'. Close: data-testid='story-close'. Progress bars are the inner divs at selector: [data-testid="story-viewer"] .flex.gap-1 > div > div and use style.width in %. Sponsored bar is static 100%. For contextmenu test, dispatch a bubbling cancelable MouseEvent('contextmenu') and read defaultPrevented — works on viewer root and on all children.

detailed_results.organic_hold_pauses: 38.0% → 38.5% over 3s (would have been ~68% unpaused). Pass with 50ms tick leak.
